[PREFERENCE] User is looking for recipe ideas for traditional Cherokee dishes.

[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 6. Smoked Turkey or Venison  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 7. Parched Corn  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 8. Wild Berry Cobbler  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 9. Cherokee Rose Petal Jelly  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 10. Sobahegwa (Wild Potato Soup)  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided a recipe for Three Sisters Soup with specific ingredients and instructions.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Ingredients for Three Sisters Soup include:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] - 1 cup dried corn (white or yellow)  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] - 1 cup dried beans (such as kidney or black beans)  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] - 1 cup diced winter squash (such as butternut or acorn)  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] - 2 tablespoons vegetable oil  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] - 1 onion, diced  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] - 2 cloves garlic, minced  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] - 1 teaspoon ground cumin  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] - 1 teaspoon paprika  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] - Salt and pepper, to taste  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] - 4 cups vegetable broth  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] - 2 cups water  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] - Optional: 1 pound ground turkey or venison, browned and drained  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided a recipe for Wild Onion and Wild Garlic Fritters with specific ingredients and instructions.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Ingredients for Wild Onion and Wild Garlic Fritters include:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] - 1 cup wild onions (ramps or wild garlic), chopped  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] - 1 cup all-purpose flour
